conditions: 20 native unpaused trajectories plus 20 seeds x 2 fixed boundaries x 2 position references x 2 wait lengths per policy. The unpaused trajectory is shared by the boundary comparisons, never counted twice.
boundary_basis: Fixed native action boundaries selected from independent development: early object interaction and payload transport. Both are chunk boundaries for both policies. Actual contact/height at entry are recorded; they are scheduled windows, not an oracle-matched physical phase across policies.
pause: After the policy query, before its first action: retain the already queried action chunk, old hidden state and observation history. Resume the frozen public policy afterward. No finetuning or altered diffusion schedule.
holding: Override native OSC absolute position goal to the true last controller goal or measured entry position. Both wrists retain the true last orientation goal; both grippers retain their previous command. Zero pose inputs prevent accidental repeated delta commands. All actual controller goals are checked.
matching: Fresh native reset, exact physical action roll-in from each checkpoint own unpaused trajectory, identical prefix physics and RGB history within policy. No claim of identical physical continuation states between different policies. No simulator state edits after reset.
completion: Unchanged native Transport task: payload in target bin and trash in trash bin, using the original 700 policy-action horizon. No pot-specific path contract is imposed.
cost: Report physical simulation time, all measured policy query and observation-acquisition services, their charged sum, and evaluation wall time. The native synchronous benchmark freezes physics during ordinary queries; only the imposed wait adds physical steps. This is not validation of a general asynchronous deployment system.

statistics.unit: whole initialization seed retaining both phases, holds, waits and policy comparisons
statistics.primary: holding-by-wait completion interaction separately within each policy and boundary; full seed denominators; no success-conditioned selection

stopping: Finish this 360-execution cohort once both public policies pass the capability gate; synchronize paper and reproduction; no alternate checkpoints, extra phases or parameter scans chosen from holding outcomes.
initialization_warmup: A common native zero-pose preparation step and a dummy policy forward materialize controller/solver/render/RNN caches before every condition starts from a fresh seeded reset. They are task initialization, not post-boundary state edits or tuned recovery.
initialization_controller_state: Clear the native Panda gripper command accumulator to its fresh-model default at each episode initialization. The native reset restores finger coordinates but otherwise leaves this accumulator from the previous episode; retaining it breaks exact physical roll-in pairing. This is initialization-only and does not alter policy weights, gains, or commands after task start.
